## Profile

I am an Associate Professor of Statistics (scientific sector STAT-01/A) in the
Department of Economics and Business Sciences at the University of Cagliari,
Italy. My research lies between computational statistics and machine learning:
I design statistical learning methods, mainly tree-based models,
clustering methods and text-mining techniques, and use them on
substantive problems with colleagues from economics, medicine, engineering and
the natural sciences.

I hold a joint PhD in Probability and Mathematical Statistics (Charles
University, Prague) and in Environmental and Applied Botany (University of
Cagliari). After a research grant and a postdoctoral fellowship in the same
department, I was an assistant professor from 2017 to 2024, and have been an
associate professor since October 2024.

Outside the university, I am the chief executive of SmartLab, an academic
spin-off of the University of Cagliari that brings business intelligence and
data science to public and private organizations.

My full curriculum vitae is available on my
[University of Cagliari page](https://web.unica.it/unica/en/ateneo_s07_ss01_sss01.page?contentId=SHD31058).

## Service to the profession

- **International Society for Business and Industrial Statistics (ISBIS):**
  member of the Executive Committee as liaison to ENBIS (2023–2027); earlier
  Vice-President for young members and chair of the y-BIS committee
  (2019–2021).
- **Scientific program committees:** IFCS 2026, ISBIS 2025, CLADAG 2025,
  ECDA 2022, CLADAG 2021, y-BIS 2019 and y-BIS 2017.
- **Conference organization:** coordinator of the local organizing committee of
  the 50th Scientific Meeting of the Italian Statistical Society (SIS 2021) at
  the University of Cagliari; member of the local organizing committees of
  PrefStat 2024, CLADAG 2015 and SIS 2014.
- **Invited sessions:** organizer of invited sessions at ENBIS, IFCS, ISBIS,
  CLADAG, ECDA and the ISI World Statistics Congress (2019–2026).
- **Refereeing:** reviewer for journals including *Computational Statistics*,
  *Statistics and Computing*, *Machine Learning*, *Statistical Methods and
  Applications*, *Statistical Analysis and Data Mining*, *Applied Stochastic
  Models in Business and Industry* and *Scientific Reports*.

## University and public roles

- Member of the board of the PhD program in Economics and Business Sciences,
  University of Cagliari (since 2019).
- Member of the Joint Teacher–Student Committee (CPDS) of the Department of
  Economics and Business Sciences.
- Representative of the University of Cagliari in the Regional Observatory on
  Poverty of the Autonomous Region of Sardinia (2025–2026) and in the
  Provincial Observatory of the Prefecture of Cagliari on the prevention of
  organized crime in the tourism sector (2025–2027).
